questions.question: Harish and Bimal can complete a task in 20 days. They worked at it for 15 days and then Bimal left. The remaining work was done by Harish alone, in 10 days. Harish alone can complete the entire task in:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Remaining days of work for **Harish + Bimal** = 20 − 15 = 5 days.

Work done by **Harish** alone in 10 days = Work done by **(Harish + Bimal)** in 5 days.

Efficiency Ratio **(Harish + Bimal) : Harish** = 10 : 5 = 2 : 1.

Since **Harish**'s efficiency is half of their combined efficiency, he takes double the time.

Time taken by **Harish** alone = 20 × 2 = 40 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 40 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 **Person**
 **Days**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**

 **Harish + Bimal**

**Given:** **Harish** and **Bimal** work together for 15 days.

⇒ Work completed in 15 days = 15 × 1 = 15 units.

⇒ Remaining work = 20 − 15 = 5 units.

⇒ **Harish** completes 5 units in 10 days.

⇒ **Harish**'s efficiency = 5 ÷ 10 = 0.5 units/day.

⇒ Time for **Harish** alone = Total Work ÷ Efficiency

⇒ Time = 20 ÷ 0.5 = 40 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 40 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Work and Efficiency Relation

Total Work = Efficiency × Time. Efficiency is inversely proportional to the time taken to complete a task.

Combined Efficiency

If person A takes x days and B takes y days, combined efficiency = (1/x + 1/y). Combined time = (x × y) ÷ (x + y).

Remaining Work Concept

Remaining work = 1 − (Work done). This is often used when a person leaves a task mid-way.</p

questions.question: The difference between the simple interest and the compound interest on Rs.5000/- at 10% per annum for 3 years is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs.5000

Rate of interest = 10% per annum 

Time = 3 years 

**Formulas used:**

Compound Interest = Amount - Principal 

⇒ Amount = P (1 + r/100)t

Simple Interest = Principal × Rate/100 × Time 

**Calculation:**

Compound Interest = 5000(1 + 10/100)³ - 5000 

⇒ 5000(110/100)³ - 5000 

⇒ 5000[11/10 × 11/10 × 11/10 - 1]

⇒ 5000[(1331 - 1000)/1000]

⇒ 5 × 331 = Rs.1655

Simple Interest = 5000 × 10/100 × 3 

⇒ Rs.1500 

Difference between compound interest & simple interest = Rs.1655 - Rs.1500

⇒ Rs.155

**∴ The required result = Rs.155**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Calculation of effective rate for compound interest:

Effective rate = x + x + x²/100 

Interest rate for 1 year = 10%

Effective rate for 2 years = 10 + 10 + (10 × 10)/100 = 10 + 10 + 1

⇒ 21%

Effective rate for 3 years = 21 + 10 + (21 × 10)/100 

⇒ 31 + 2.1 = 33.1% 

or

At 10% per annum for 3 years 

Rate = 10% × 3 = 30%

**∴ Difference between the CI and SI for 3 years = 5000 × 3.1/100 **

**⇒ Rs.155**

questions.question: If x+(1)/(x)=9, then the value of x²+(1)/(x²) is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Apply the direct **algebraic identity** for expressions of the form **x + 1/x = k**.

The shortcut formula to find **x² + 1/x²** is **k² − 2**.

Given: **k = 9**

Calculation: 9² − 2 ⇒ 81 − 2 = 79.

**∴ The correct answer is 79.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** x + 1/x = 9

**Formula Used:** (a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/93f45251ef3609773fdf733d0c04a2d13babfd1bc90bf52c939b7a530a327456.png] 

To find the value of **x² + 1/x²**, we perform **squaring on both sides** of the given equation:

⇒ (x + 1/x)² = 9²

⇒ x² + (1/x)² + 2 × x × (1/x) = 81

⇒ x² + 1/x² + 2 = 81

⇒ x² + 1/x² = 81 − 2

⇒ x² + 1/x² = 79

**∴ The correct answer is 79.**

**__Additional Information__**

Square of Difference Identity

If x − 1/x = k, then squaring both sides gives x² + 1/x² = k² + 2.

Cubic Identity (Sum)

If x + 1/x = k, then cubing both sides gives x³ + 1/x³ = k³ − 3k.

Cubic Identity (Difference)

If x − 1/x = k, then cubing both sides gives x³ − 1/x³ = k³ + 3k.

Power 4 Transformation

If x² + 1/x² = m, then x⁴ + 1/x⁴ = m² − 2.</p
